name: Small language model (SLM)
short_description: A small language model is a compact AI language model with far fewer parameters than a large language model, so it needs less compute and can be focused on a narrow domain or run on local devices.

evidence.quote: what's your view on the small or special language models?
You don't need large language models always, small language models also very useful.
It might be running on your device or hosted as a small model in Foundry.
